svg.title: Cozy Night Window — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: Moonlit window, tea, plant, rug, and a curled-up cat. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
svg.metadata: {"slug": "cozy-window", "title": "Cozy Night Window", "desc": "Moonlit window, tea, plant, rug, and a curled-up cat.", "tags": ["Interior", "Night", "Cozy", "OurSpace Original"], "palette": [{"hex": "#F4E5C2", "name": "Cream"}, {"hex": "#C97B63", "name": "Coral"}, {"hex": "#6F8F72", "name": "Sage"}, {"hex": "#4C6658", "name": "Pine"}, {"hex": "#D8A657", "name": "Ochre"}, {"hex": "#8C5C4A", "name": "Clay"}, {"hex": "#A9B8A3", "name": "Mist"}, {"hex": "#E9B4A6", "name": "Blush"}, {"hex": "#5D4A43", "name": "Espresso"}, {"hex": "#D9C8A9", "name": "Sand"}, {"hex": "#7E9C8E", "name": "Sea Glass"}, {"hex": "#B96B55", "name": "Ember"}, {"hex": "#EFE7D8", "name": "Porcelain"}, {"hex": "#3D5148", "name": "Moss"}, {"hex": "#C08F57", "name": "Berry"}, {"hex": "#8A735F", "name": "Marigold"}, {"hex": "#E3C47D", "name": "Violet"}, {"hex": "#768D6E", "name": "Lagoon"}, {"hex": "#B78072", "name": "Honey"}, {"hex": "#556C74", "name": "Mauve"}, {"hex": "#D7A58B", "name": "Leaf"}, {"hex": "#9A826D", "name": "Poppy"}, {"hex": "#C5D6C8", "name": "Sky"}, {"hex": "#6E4B44", "name": "Umber"}], "complexity": "Moderate"}
